0022600101.text: The Warriors (0-1, 3rd in the Pacific and 1 game back, 13th in the West) host the Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest, 6th in the West) in Golden State's second game of the 2026-27 season, after a loss to open the year while Memphis has won its only game so far. Golden State is without Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandin Podziemski is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision. Memphis is missing Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain), both day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet this season after the Warriors won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 133-112 in Memphis on February 25, 2026.
